name: sylvan-librarian-cloudflare
description: Sylvan Librarian, ported to run natively on Cloudflare Workers + KV + Durable Objects — free-plan deployable

scripts.build: bun run build:wasm && bun run build:wasm-import
scripts.build:wasm: cd engine/wasm && ../../scripts/with-rust.sh wasm-pack build --target bundler --release --out-dir pkg
scripts.build:wasm-import: scripts/with-rust.sh cargo rustc --release -p sylvan-wasm-import --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -- -C link-arg=--max-memory=117440512 && cp target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/sylvan_wasm_import.wasm engine/wasm-import/pkg/
